title: EMerge upstream: Demo 3 coupled line filter
summary: Native parameter/source wrapper for the pinned upstream default. Requires a compatible external EMerge3 runtime; wrapper is not solver qualification.
assumptions: Original source and LICENSE are retained byte-for-byte in the isolated upstream pack.
Numeric scalar overrides use the units and conventions in the original script; integers remain integers.

Interactive view/show calls are suppressed; bounded numerical curves and spatial samples retain explicit stride and provenance. Desktop execution serializes sweeps, permits automatic solver selection and bounds adaptive refinement to two steps. Edit execution_options in the script for an unrestricted study; this is not convergence qualification.

Scalar/vector spatial display samples are captured in native views; full samples are preserved in NPZ sidecars. Gmsh surface-corner previews retain original solver coordinates and mesh sidecars. Parametric CAD, port-mode overlays and Smith grids are not converted.
Runtime compatibility and numerical convergence must be checked per example.
expected: Original example behavior at unchanged parameter defaults, subject to installed engine compatibility.
Execution record and available numerical curves; no synthetic replacement results.

script.code:
from pathlib import Path
import os, runpy
resource_root=Path(os.environ.get('SPIKE_HOME') or os.environ.get('SPIKE_WORKSPACE') or Path.cwd())
bridge=resource_root/'examples'/'upstream-emerge'/'bridge.py'
if not bridge.is_file():
    raise RuntimeError('EMerge example resources are unavailable; select a SPIKE-Em source/resource root with SPIKE_HOME')
# Desktop profile preserves geometry/frequencies, serializes sweep jobs and lets EMerge select an available solver.
execution_options={'serial_sweep': True, 'solver': 'AUTO', 'max_adaptive_steps': 2}
runpy.run_path(str(bridge))['run_example']('examples/demo3_coupled_line_filter.py', study_parameters, spike, execution_options)
